title: Seminar in Modern Art I (1870-1945)
description:
Intensive study of artistic practice in the modern period. Geographic and cultural area and choice of issue may vary depending on instructor.
Revising MTO to reflect policy language.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of AHVS 460, HA 460 (if taken in the same topic).
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate course.
